sources.locator: "Battle of Vimeiro", revision 1370623683, § Background and § Prelude

explanation: The Vimeiro article makes the earlier battle the thing its own position came out of: "The British intervention started with the Battle of Roliça", and "After Roliça, Wellesley had established a position near Vimeiro." Four days separate them and the same army fought both. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
